data.exact_reserve_text: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 13.8m (2015: GBP 7.2m) includes a deterioration of GBP 0.7m in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2016 were GBP 14.168m. The claims development tables and notes indicate a small adverse re-estimation of prior years, dominated by 2011, with an aggregate gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 0.274m (1.9% of opening reserves). The report also contains a narrative reference to a GBP 0.7m deterioration in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end; the triangle-based calculation yields a +GBP 0.274m gross prior-year strengthening. No specific named catastrophe events are cited as driving this prior-year movement.
raw_causal_phrases: includes a deterioration of GBP 0.7m in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development derived from the gross claims development table (triangle). The report narrative also mentions a GBP 0.7m deterioration in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end; triangle-derived gross PYD = +GBP 0.274m. The GBP 0.7m figure is a narrative reference to claims incurred and may represent a different accounting view (P&L claims incurred phrasing); the triangle calculation is used as the gross PYD source per the rules.
